_about.what: Generic (SAE J2012 / J1979) diagnostic trouble codes — the codes that mean the SAME thing on every make of car. A DTC is the 5-character fault code an engine computer stores when something goes wrong, e.g. 'P0217'.
_about.scope: Generic ranges only: P0xxx, P2xxx, P34xx-P39xx, C0xxx, B0xxx, U0xxx. Manufacturer-specific codes (P1xxx, C1/C2, B1/B2, U1/U2) mean different things per make and are deliberately NOT in this file — see DIAG-3 in BACKLOG.md.
_about.why_a_file: This list is fixed by a published standard, so it is reference data, not application state. Keeping it in the repo means a wrong description shows up as a reviewable diff, and the decoder stays a pure function that needs no database to run. JSON (rather than a Python dict) so the planned Go port (GO-1) can read the exact same catalog.

fields.description: Plain-language meaning shown to the driver. From the standard — do not paraphrase loosely.
fields.severity: OUR editorial call (critical | warning | info), not spec data. 'critical' = can strand the driver or damage the engine if ignored. Anything absent from this file defaults to 'info'.

_about.editing: Add codes in ascending order. Never bulk-import severity from a scraped source; import descriptions only and set severity by hand.
